description: The pie chart presents the distribution of bias categories in the paper “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse,” showing 4 slices in total. The slices are labeled “Right bias” (blue) at approximately 30.0% with an internal label “30.0% (30),” “Left bias” (orange) at approximately 28.0% with “28.0% (28),” an unlabeled green slice at approximately 22.0% with “22.0% (22),” and “Left center bias” (red) at approximately 20.0% with “20.0% (20).” Percentage and count labels appear inside each slice, and the category names are placed around the pie rather than in a separate legend; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear to follow a strictly descending order around the circle.
